title: Lantern and Typewriter
author: Vesper Vane
blurb: Freya Ashgrove, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
